node.title: L1 official checkpoint characteristic atlas
node.statement: For every official order n=2^s with 13<=s<=44, generated-field characteristic p<n, n|p^f-1, and p^f<2^256, the proved floor p>=3583 forces ord_n(p) in {1,2,4,8,16}. Enumerating the 32 low-order residues +-5^(j*2^(s-6)) and applying exact primality and field-cap filters gives precisely 59 possible (n,p) pairs. Their floor(n/p) histogram is {1:33,2:10,3:4,4:4,5:2,7:1,8:4,16:1}. The split-value theorems make 33 m=1 and six broad m=2 minimum-width strata empty; four remainder-two m=2 rows have exactly n/2 antipodal pairs; only 16 m>=3 rows retain a general minimum-width endpoint. No m<=2 compute remains. This is an exhaustive arithmetic router, not a higher-width or L1 bound.
